usage: 魚蛋腸粉 is used as a noun referring to a type of dim sum dish made of rice noodle rolls filled with fish balls.
You can use 魚蛋腸粉 when ordering food at a dim sum restaurant.
It can be the subject or object of a sentence, for example, 'I like 魚蛋腸粉' or 'He is eating 魚蛋腸粉'.
The word 魚蛋腸粉 rarely changes form and is usually used together with verbs related to eating or ordering.
